rv.q: It's a good time, but in sacrificing plot for hijinks, it runs aground.
Aaron Kaplan's music certainly adds a great deal to this show, but to be honest, I think it was just a little long and perhaps a bit to slapstick.

cn.t: Stage Left Theatre's storefront production of this Chicago legend falls short as theatrical antics overshadow the compelling true story of Cap Streeter and the founding of Streeterville.
